uutiset.t: Ontario Teachers’ CEO Says ‘Very Long’ AI Buildout Imperils Bets
uutiset.s: Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan Chief Executive Officer Jo Taylor said the success of artificial intelligence will hinge on how long it takes to build infrastructure for the technology.

uutiset.t: CoreWeave’s Banks to Sell $4.5 Billion Meta-Tied Loan Next Week
uutiset.s: CoreWeave Inc.’s bankers at Morgan Stanley and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group Inc. are preparing a $4.5 billion loan sale for as soon as next week, with the financing secured by graphics processing units for Meta Platforms Inc.

uutiset.t: One Thing In Markets To Be Thankful For
Gold Slumps on Rate Hike Outlook, AI Stocks Selloff
uutiset.s: Gold slid below $3,500 an ounce as a selloff in stocks continued and a key inflation print reinforced bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes. uutiset.t: Michael Burry Is More Long Than Short After Dumping Nasdaq Puts
uutiset.s: The selloff in technology stocks has left investor Michael Burry, who became famous for betting against the US mortgage market in 2008, with more long equity positions than short ones after unloading his put options on the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index.

uutiset.t: US Army Detonates Explosives Cache in Middletown, Iowa
uutiset.s: The US Army blew up five tons of hazardous materials stored at a facility in Iowa, with early indications suggesting planners had averted the worst-case scenario of a massive cloud of toxic lead. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Anthropic’s Post-IPO Struggles Contrast With SpaceX’s Early Days
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC is experiencing a rougher initiation to public markets than SpaceX, and a host of market and technical factors threaten to weigh down its stock performance before the Claude developer reports for the first time as a public company early next year.

uutiset.t: CoreWeave, Nvidia Credit Risk Hit Fresh Highs as AI Woes Mount
uutiset.s: CoreWeave Inc. and Nvidia Corp. credit-risk measures hit fresh all-time highs Wednesday while gauges of perceived worry again reached levels last seen in March, as Wall Street grew increasingly concerned about the tech sector’s record borrowing to finance artificial intelligence.

uutiset.t: Russian Refinery Runs Drop to Lowest in Decades, Rystad Says
uutiset.s: Russia’s oil processing rates have plunged to the lowest in more than two decades as Ukraine continues to strike refineries, according to Rystad Energy, heaping pressure on the country’s domestic fuel supplies.

uutiset.t: Core PCE Momentum Remained Elevated in October
uutiset.s: US consumer spending stalled in October after surging earlier in the year, suggesting households took a breather heading into the holiday season. Inflation-adjusted personal spending was little changed from a month earlier, according to Bureau of Economic Analysis data released Wednesday. Mike Reid,

uutiset.t: JPMorgan Backs Drone Engine Maker’s Muni Sale in Wisconsin
uutiset.s: A drone engine manufacturer is making its debut in the US municipal bond market with a familiar name standing behind the debt: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

uutiset.t: Embraer Shares Sink as US Threatens Brazil Aircraft Tariff
uutiset.s: Embraer SA shares fell the most in more than six months after the US proposed a 10% tariff on aircraft from Brazil, threatening the planemaker’s business in one of its most important markets.

uutiset.t: Stocks Selloff Hits Unlikely Market, Sinking Carry Trade
uutiset.s: One of Wall Street’s most reliable wagers of 2026 is starting to lose its surefire status.

uutiset.t: BC Partners Buys GSE Agency With Golfer DeChambeau on List
uutiset.s: BC Partners’ credit arm has agreed to buy a majority stake in GSE Worldwide, a sports marketing agency which represents athletes such as golf celebrity Bryson DeChambeau and former NFL and MLB star Bo Jackson.

uutiset.t: Aareal Bank Offers Over 12% Premium on Riskiest Part of SRT
uutiset.s: Aareal Bank AG is set to pay investors a premium of more than 12% to hedge part of the risk on a commercial real estate lending book worth around €2.5 billion ($2.7 billion) in only its second such deal.
